text:
Jen (Sales): incoming RFI from Northfield Health. they want capability matrix, POC pricing, and data residency answers. attaching RFI PDF: https://redwood.internal/rfqs/NF-2025-RFI.pdf
Mike (SE): saw it. key asks: 1) private VPC + on-prem option 2) HSM/KMS 3) SLA 99.9
Priya (Solutions): I'll draft a POC plan. propose 2-week eval (ingest 5-10M tokens), can run on Dedicated or Private. baseline tasks: connectivity, ingest sample dataset, latency & cost benchmarks, accuracy evals.
Anika (Security): note: they require key import to HSM, SOC2 + ISO27001, annual pen test reports, and data deletion cert. Also need vendor security questionnaire answers (they'll send a big spreadsheet).
Tom (Legal): will need DPA + DPA data residency addendum. if on-prem, indemnity language must be limited. I'll draft redlines.
rfi-bot: Ticket created: RFI-2025-1187. Assigned to @Jen. SLA 3d for initial response.
Jen (Sales): thanks. immediate asks: 1) can we provide HSM key import for Private? 2) rough POC pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted for 2-week POC (est. 5M tokens, 8 v100-hours)?
Mike (SE): HSM import: yes for Private deployments with HSM integration — needs ops time to configure (2-3 days). For Dedicated we can do KMS but not import. POC pricing: Hosted: $X flat + token usage; Dedicated POC: $6k/day reserved (example) + infra. (I'll put numbers in spreadsheet)
Priya (Solutions): POC plan skeleton attached: ```
POC Plan: Northfield Health
- Week 0: kickoff & network
- Week 1: ingest samples, latency baselines
- Week 2: eval prompts, opt for quantized model if cost
Acceptance: latency < 250ms p95, embedding quality pass on eval set
Deliverables: capability matrix, cost model, final report
```
Anika (Security): for the spreadsheet Qs, I'll answer the cryptography & auth rows. Assign me the questionnaire.
Jen (Sales): @Priya can you add a capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private (features: HSM, data residency, SLA, burst, pricing model) and attach CSV. Need to return RFI in 4 business days.
Priya (Solutions): will do, will include a CSV snippet: ```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
HSM,no,limited,yes
DataResidency,regional,regional,customer-controlled
SLA,90/10,99.9,99.9
Burst,Burst eligible,configurable,manual
```
Tom (Legal): will review the capability wording, avoid definitive "yes" on HSM for hosted. use "supported on Private with HSM integration".
Mike (SE): I'll run quick perf numbers on the suggested models and paste sample tail-latency numbers later today.
Jen (Sales): thanks team. I'll coordinate with Northfield to schedule kickoff (prefer Tue morning). tagging follow ups: @Mike (SE) perf numbers, @Priya capability matrix + CSV, @Anika questionnaire answers, @Tom DPA redlines.
Priya (Solutions): uploading draft matrix CSV and POC pricing spreadsheet to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RFI-2025-1187/attachments
Mike (SE): quick note: if they request HSM for hosted, we should propose Private + migration plan. that reduces ambiguity.
Anika (Security): will need asset inventory and org chart from them for the questionnaire. ask them to provide SOC2 cert copy.
Jen (Sales): closing loop — I'll send a short beat to Northfield: thanks, we aim to return RFI in 4 business days and propose kickoff for the POC. :thumbsup:
rfi-bot: Reminder scheduled: RFI-2025-1187 — due in 3 days.
Jen (Sales): updated last message: Northfield confirmed kickoff Tue 10am PT, added security contact: julia@northfield.health
